chunks: And it is narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār that he said:
Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام said to me: “When you doubt, then build upon certainty.”
He said: I said, “Is this a principle?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.فَابْنِ: then build or proceed on that basis

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in prayer when they become doubtful?
ai.summary: This hadith states a foundational juristic principle: when doubt arises, one should act on what is certain. In the context of prayer, it guides the mukallaf to return to established certainty rather than unstable doubt.
